verdict.rationale: Treg documents a catalog API for programmatic discovery. Agents can search by intent via `GET /catalog/search?q=...` and compare providers via `/catalog/platforms/{slug}` with success rate, speed and price. Every catalogued endpoint carries its price, parameters and an example response, and probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec and an llms.txt protocol guide. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the catalog search endpoints return useful results, and explicit discovery of MCP servers as opposed to provider tools/endpoints.
